# Ritik Patni

> Frontend developer and wildlife/macro photographer. One site, one set of sections: engineering notes and a newsletter, a photography gallery, a reading library, and an about page.

## Sections
- Journal (engineering overview, recent notes and dispatches): https://ritikpatni.me/coding
- Notes (blog posts and newsletter issues): https://ritikpatni.me/blog
- Gallery (wildlife, bird and macro photography): https://ritikpatni.me/photography
- Library (books and reading highlights): https://ritikpatni.me/library
- Uses (tools and gear): https://ritikpatni.me/uses
- About (background and contact links): https://ritikpatni.me/about

## Resources
- Full content (all posts, notes, books, highlights): https://ritikpatni.me/llms-full.txt
